name: apigee-ai-demos
description: Apigee AI Demos portal with Google (@google.com) auth, VM user provisioning, and browser-based IronRDP WASM access to xrdp

scripts.build:wasm: cd wasm && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && rm -rf ../public/wasm && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/rdp_wasm.wasm --target web --no-typescript --out-dir ../public/wasm
